{Ohh:f{.mXA!yQZ^#M3D: Hi, I’m Gitanjali Rao. Welcome to the Invention Station!
When I’m inventing, I like to build my idea as soon as possible, so that I'm able to visualize it and I have more motivation to keep going.
In this project, you can drag each object to the box to create your own invention.
Remix this project and add your own object sprites. You can also customize the objects using the Paint Editor.
Record a message to play or write a message about what your invention does and what it is called when the “My Invention” button is clicked.
Create something awesome that helps the world!
